summary: SMJ International Holdings, a NYSE American-listed Singapore lumber wholesaler, disclosed receipt of an October 6, 2026 NYSE Regulation public warning letter for violating Section 401(a) of the Company Guide. The violation stemmed from delayed disclosure of the September 29, 2026 resignations of executive director Lee Lay Choo and CFO Low Yeen Mei Sherina, which were not publicly filed until October 1, 2026. NYSE staff had previously reminded the company of its obligations on February 17 and August 27, 2026 amid trading-activity inquiries. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were stated. Watch for escalating regulatory scrutiny and potential delisting risk.
